articles.title: James Anderson: England's all-time leading Test wicket-taker to get knighthood
articles.description: England's all-time leading Test wicket-taker James Anderson is to be given a knighthood for services to cricket.
articles.content:
England's all-time leading Test wicket-taker James Anderson is to be given a knighthood for services to cricket.
Anderson, 42, retired from Test cricket last summer with 704 wickets.
